power.answer: Eurowings' news page says power banks stay in hand luggage only. Up to 100 Wh you can bring one without restriction; 100 to 160 Wh you can bring up to two, each with the airline's pre-approval; above 160 Wh they are not allowed. The Wh rating must be visible, or traceable through volts and mAh.

sections.h: 🔋 What Eurowings says about power banks
sections.p: From the Eurowings news item "New rules from January 2026: What's changing for your power bank on board" (15 January 2026), read on 23 November 2026.

head: Question
Eurowings rule
rows: Hand luggage only, never checked baggage
Up to two, each needing the airline's pre-approval
Wh rating must be visible, or traceable through volts and mAh

list: Not on this page: whether a power bank may be used or charged on board, and where to send the approval request. Ask Eurowings before you fly.

faq: Can I check a power bank on Eurowings?
No. Eurowings says power banks remain hand-luggage only.
What if my power bank does not show its Wh rating?
Eurowings says it must be clearly traceable through other values such as volts and mAh.
